question: Which of the following persons was conferred with the 57th Jnanpith Award?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Damodar Mauzo.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Damodar Mauzo **is a** ******Goan short story writer, author, critic, and scriptwriter in Konkani**. **
 
• **The 57th Jnanpith Award** was awarded to **Damodar Mauzo, a 77-year-old Konkani author.**
 
• He was achieved **the Jnanpith Award (India's highest literary honour) in 2021**,** Sahitya Akademi Award in 1983** for his notable novels such as **Karmelin and the Vimala V.**
 
• He has worked as a member of the **executive board, general council,** as well as** finance committee of the ****Sahitya Akademi. **
 
• **Mauzo's books** are Tsunami Simon and Karmelin, as well as short stories like other stories from **Goa and Teresa's Man.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Krishna Sobti **was an **Indian Hindi-language fiction author and essayist**.

 
 
• She won the **Sahitya Akademi Award in 1980** for her novel **Zindaginama and in 1996,** was granted the** Sahitya Akademi Fellowship.**
 
 
 
• **Kedarnath Singh **was an **Indian poet who composed in Hindi**.
 
• He was also a notable critic and essayist.
 
 
• He was awarded the** Jnanpith Award (2013)**, and **Sahitya Akademi Award (1989)** in Hindi for his poetry collection,** Akaal Mein Saras (Cranes in Drought).**
 
 
 
• **Amitav Ghosh **is an **Indian author, famous for his English language historical fiction**.
